goal: Consolidate the converter to one tested ES-module implementation, make matching and detection data-driven and token-based, surface conversion warnings, then add New Recruit export.
architecture: index.html becomes a thin UI shell importing ES modules from src/js/ (parse, match, items, detect, generate, report). All game knowledge comes from shipped data files in src/data/ (OWB faction JSONs today; generated army-compositions, unit-name-index, and NR catalogue indexes added by build scripts in scripts/). Node assertion tests in test/ import the same modules the page runs.
tech_stack: Vanilla ES modules, Tailwind CDN, Node 18+ (node:test) for tests and build scripts. No bundler, no runtime dependencies; fast-xml-parser as devDependency for Phase E only.

phases.name: Consolidate to one implementation with real tests
phases.rationale: Every later fix must land in exactly one place. Extract the live inline implementation from index.html into ES modules, delete the two dead layers (old src/ modules and the unused inline matcher), and replace the print-only test scripts with assertions against the extracted modules.

tasks.name: Extract inline implementation into src/js/ ES modules
tasks.verification: node -e "await import('./src/js/parse.js'); await import('./src/js/match.js'); await import('./src/js/items.js'); await import('./src/js/detect.js'); await import('./src/js/generate.js'); console.log('ok')"
tasks.done_when: All five modules import cleanly in Node and export the functions listed in the task file; no fetch/DOM references inside them.

tasks.name: Rewire index.html to import modules and delete inline copies
tasks.verification: npm run serve (background), then convert the Skaven test list from CLAUDE.md in a browser via preview tools; grep -c 'function parseWithFactionData' index.html returns 0
tasks.done_when: index.html contains only UI code plus fetch loaders; conversion of the Skaven test list downloads a JSON identical in shape to before extraction; zero parser/matcher/generator function bodies remain inline.

tasks.name: Replace demo test scripts with assertions; delete dead src modules
tasks.done_when: npm test runs node --test and passes; asserts 10 anchors and 2197 points for the Skaven fixture and faction detection returns 'skaven'; src/parser, src/matcher, src/generator and the three old test scripts are deleted.

phases.name: Token-based matching
phases.rationale: Substring search across whole unit blocks is the root cause of wrong equipment, options, and magic items. Replace it with per-token classification scoped to each entry line, and scope magic items to the detected faction.

tasks.name: Rewrite extractOptions as per-token classification
tasks.done_when: extractOptions consumes comma/bullet tokens instead of substring-scanning the block; returns unknownTokens; Skaven fixture units match with correct command/equipment and no false-positive options; all match tests pass.

tasks.name: Scope magic item index to the detected faction
tasks.done_when: buildMagicItemIndex(magicItems, 'skaven') contains general + skaven items only (plus mapped special categories for factions that have them); a Bretonnian virtue is not matchable from a Skaven list; tests pass.

tasks.name: Fix magic item placement (character vs champion vs banner)
tasks.done_when: Character items land in unit.items slots by type; banners land on the Standard Bearer's magic.selected; champion slots are used only for items tokenized from a champion sub-line; generated Skaven JSON matches the shape of reference-files/tree-army_owb.json entries.

phases.name: Data-driven faction and Army of Infamy detection
phases.rationale: Detection must come from the data we already ship, not hand-typed lists. Build generated indexes (unit-name index, official composition slugs from the OWB repo), then rewrite detection to consume them.

tasks.name: Build script for unit-name index and official army-composition slugs
tasks.verification: node scripts/build-data.mjs && node -e "const i=require('./src/data/owb/unit-name-index.json'); const c=require('./src/data/owb/army-compositions.json'); if(!i['clanrats']||!c['wood-elf-realms']) process.exit(1); console.log('ok')"
tasks.done_when: unit-name-index.json maps every unit name (all 17 factions) to its faction slug(s); army-compositions.json lists official OWB composition slugs and display names per faction, sourced from the OWB repo (verified: contains orions-wild-hunt, not orion's-wild-hunt).

tasks.name: Rewrite detection to consume generated indexes
tasks.done_when: Faction scoring uses unit-name-index.json (full rosters, not curated lists); getArmyCompositions returns official slugs from army-compositions.json; AoI detection flags header mentions and AoI-restricted options/items; hard-coded FACTION_CONFIG.uniqueUnits and naive slug generation are deleted.

tasks.name: Wire UI to new detection API
tasks.verification: npm run serve; paste Skaven list -> dropdown shows official compositions; paste a Host of Talsyn-heavy Wood Elf list -> dropdown auto-selects host-of-talsyn
tasks.done_when: Dropdown values are official OWB slugs; detection hint shows; exported armyComposition field round-trips into old-world-builder.com without error.

phases.name: Honest feedback panel
phases.rationale: Silent unit drops and unreported unknown tokens are why bad exports look successful. Build a structured conversion report and render it before download.

tasks.name: Structured conversion report module
tasks.done_when: buildReport returns matched/dropped units, unknown tokens per unit, and a points check (parsed anchor points vs computed OWB points per unit and total); tests cover a list with one unmatchable unit and one unknown token.

tasks.name: Render report in feedback panel
tasks.verification: npm run serve; convert a list containing a misspelled unit and confirm the panel shows it as dropped with a warning before download
tasks.done_when: Panel shows matched count vs total, lists dropped units and unknown tokens as warnings, shows per-unit and total point mismatches; download still proceeds but never silently.

phases.name: New Recruit export
phases.rationale: NR needs BattleScribe catalogue UUIDs that OWB data does not contain. Extract a per-faction index from the community .cat files at build time, generate roster JSON from the same matched intermediate representation, and enable the UI toggle.

tasks.name: Build NR catalogue index from .cat/.gst files
tasks.verification: node scripts/build-nr-data.mjs --faction skaven && node -e "const d=require('./src/data/nr/skaven.json'); if(!d.catalogueId||!d.units.length) process.exit(1); console.log(d.units.length + ' units')"
tasks.done_when: Script clones/reads the vflam repo, parses .gst + .cat with fast-xml-parser, and emits per-faction JSON with catalogueId, entryIds, costs, and option/upgrade entryIds sufficient to emit roster selections; skaven and wood-elf-realms generated and committed.

tasks.name: NR roster generator
tasks.done_when: generateNRJson(matchedList) emits a roster matching reference-files/In_The_Pines_-_Logan_s_Lair_-__To_Test_.json structure (roster > forces > selections with entryId, categories, costs); Skaven fixture produces selections for all 10 entries with correct total cost; validated by manual import into newrecruit.eu.

tasks.name: Enable New Recruit UI toggle
tasks.verification: npm run serve; select New Recruit, convert Skaven fixture, downloaded file imports into newrecruit.eu
tasks.done_when: Toggle enabled; format switch routes to generateNRJson with .json filename NR accepts; feedback panel reports NR-specific gaps (units missing from NR index) as warnings.
